newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures steady to up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures steady to up in thin trade.

text.p: July 17 - U.S. debt futures were steady to higher in very quiet morning trade. Sept T-bond dipped earlier after strong Philly Fed but was now caught near 114-22/32, Wednesday's close. Trader noted support in Sept T-bond at 114-15/32 to 18/32. Market action minimal, few featured players, traders said. Resistance at 115-3/32.
